answer: PoA can raise the cost of Sybil creation by binding each agent to an enclave key and verifying a hardware-rooted attestation quote for an approved MRENCLAVE. Since MRENCLAVE identifies measured code, not a unique chip, preventing VM-only duplication also requires enrollment controls for hardware credentials and replay. Sable, pearl, and trellis may label agents, but labels alone provide no Sybil resistance.
